releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.5 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Fast-Forward & Skip Video Glyphs: Visual and node detection for ⏭, ▶|, ⏩ landscape video and end-card ads (e.g. Candy Crush)
* Google Play Landscape Overlay Sheet: In-app overlay detection with automatic back-arrow click and instant back dismissal
* Compact Circled Cross: Multi-scale visual stencil with r=5, 6px radii for high-density portrait interstitial ads (e.g. Oswaal AdMob)
* Upgraded Trapped Ad Fallback: Staged precision top-right (~4s), top-left (~7-8s), and gentle back (~11s) taps across landscape & portrait orientations
* Version bumped to v1.0.5 (Build 6)
